definitions.gloss: silver screen; the movies; the cinema world
definitions.explanation: A literary word for the movie screen, and by extension the world of cinema. Often used when speaking of film as a glamorous art form.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{銀幕|ぎんまく}のスターだった。
examples.english: She was a star of the silver screen.

examples.japanese: その{俳優|はいゆう}は{久|ひさ}しぶりに{銀幕|ぎんまく}に{戻|もど}ってきた。
examples.english: That actor returned to the silver screen after a long absence.

examples.japanese: {昭和|しょうわ}の{銀幕|ぎんまく}を{彩|いろど}った{名優|めいゆう}たちの{展示|てんじ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw an exhibition of the great actors who graced the silver screen of the Showa era.

notes:
Literally "silver curtain." Early movie screens had a silvery, reflective surface, which gave rise to the name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀幕|ぎんまく}のスター: a star of the silver screen
- {銀幕|ぎんまく}デビュー: a film debut
- {銀幕|ぎんまく}を{飾|かざ}る: to grace the screen

USAGE:
{銀幕|ぎんまく} is a somewhat literary, nostalgic word, used most often for classic cinema. For everyday talk about movies, {映画|えいが} is the normal word.
